Mixture of Experts is less about having dedicated expert models on a specific topic and more a performance optimization; in practice, you divide your model into experts so it scales better (the experts don't have to communicate with one another), and while some systems (ie: Switch Transformers), do select a single "best" expert, usually the best systems use fine-grained MoE where you add together the output of several experts together, and the entire system (the Mixture) is meant to approximate a standard dense feedforward network.
